_comment: Live map for a model trained on C-MAPSS only. Use it when edge/artifacts
config/live_map.json points at ref_dataset 'xjtu', which has no statistics in
a C-MAPSS-only norm_stats.json, so Predictor() refuses to start against it.
That refusal is correct - normalising with a dataset the model never saw
would produce a confident number from the wrong constants.
The 15 channels are the informative C-MAPSS sensors, in the order the parser
near-constant sensors (1,5,10,16,18,19) are dropped upstream in the parser.
domain_id 0 matches the value in the cached units' meta.
